pc.note: Final v2 campaign ledger plus a conservative 60-second transition margin; shared 40 CPU-hour cap is not reset.

protocol.hypothesis: The v2 filter was correctly targeted but expired too soon: 37 post-override contested moves were redirected, yet invalid actions fell by only 0.075/game. Retaining the same filter after the first escape should reduce invalid actions by at least 0.12/game versus v2 while preserving its loop reduction.
protocol.changed_factor: The contested-destination filter horizon changes from four decisions after each escape to the remainder of that episode. The filter still changes only a chosen directional move into a tile occupied by or one step from an opponent.
protocol.controls: All arms use the identical frozen checkpoint, guard trigger, escape choice, features, action mask, scenarios, opponents, seeds, slots, and evaluator. No training, reward, architecture, bomb-rule, or non-contested action change.
protocol.decision: Confirm only persistent_guard if it passes every original safety and primary gate and reduces pooled invalid actions by at least 0.12/game versus cooldown_guard.

selection: Both fresh pilot blocks must pass before the fixed fresh confirmation. Never promote automatically.
fallback_if_failed: Retain every row and continue only with a prospectively registered anti-loop iteration inside the same shared budget and deadline.
